attributes.action: Better working conditions for bus drivers
attributes.additional_details: Require better conditions for UK bus drivers: clean permanent toilets at all rest stops, fair accountability so companies are responsible for unrealistic schedules and staffing issues, pay aligned closer to train drivers, bonuses tax-free, fair choice of annual leave dates with real flexibility, monthly confidential wellbeing checks via an independent provider, and rota flexibility for Muslim prayer needs while keeping services running safely. Bus drivers deserve dignity and fair treatment.
attributes.background: Require bus companies to provide permanent toilets at all driver rest points, improve pay to match train drivers, make bonuses tax-free, allow fair choice of annual leave dates, provide monthly wellbeing checks, faith-based rota adjustments and hold companies accountable for operational failures.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action. We can also only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

We understand that your request is about improving working conditions for bus drivers, but we're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. For instance, we're unsure what specifically you mean by fair choice of annual leave dates, and unrealistic schedules, and what your requests are in relation to ensuring fair accountability for such matters.
 
You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do, setting out the actions you would like to be taken.
